messages:
aj: Vendor just pushed an update — allocation for H100 shorted ~40% this quarter. Also flagged a returned batch stuck in FRA customs (HS code dispute). Need quick decision: reroute replacements to US pool (faster, +$6k freight) or hold for EU delivery (2–3w delay). cc @lara @derek
lara: Do we have the vendor's formal email? serial list? I need to check depot queues.
aj: pasted vendor excerpt below — they included serials and a tentative AWB for a split-shipment.
aj: ```Vendor: We can re-route 20x H100 to US hub (JFK) with expedited air at +$6,000. Remaining 35 units will ship to FRA and clear customs in 2–3 weeks pending HS clarification. Affected serials: SN-A1..A20 (re-route), SN-B1..B35 (EU). AWB-proposed: FX123456789NL / FX987654321NL.```
derek: EU edge pools are at ~86% utilization for the week; accepting US re-route helps global throughput but increases per-unit op cost. If we reroute, we should prioritize EU-serving clusters with loaners.
ev: +1 on cost question — what's the net impact vs SLA penalties if we fall short in EU? need rough dollars. :thinking_face:
sophie: Ops says we have ~12 loaner H100s in FRA staging that can be pushed to critical nodes for 2–3w, but that burns spare capacity for other waves. Could buy top-off instead.
lara: If vendor will only reroute 20, we need procurement to try for another 10–15 top-off or push canary reductions. @evan can you run a quick cost delta?
ev: I'll model it. Quick inputs: expedited freight +$6k for 20 = $120k. If we top-off 15 by spot purchase at premium, estimate ~$1.1M extra. SLA shortfall penalties: depends on customer tier, but rough expected MRR impact is small vs hardware spend — will calc.
logistics-bot: Tracking note created for FX123456789NL -> propose tranship JFK. Current status: vendor-scheduled, pickup pending.
ops-bot: Temporary pool created: eu-rma-temp-12. Assigned loaners: FRA-LOANER-01..12. Tagging clusters eu-edge-1..3 to receive loaners.
derek: Proposed path: Accept vendor reroute for the 20 -> move to US pool and earmark 12 FRA loaners to cover critical EU tiers. Procurement to pursue 15 spot top-off. If procurement fails within 72h, throttle noncritical EU jobs and enable soft-fallback to smaller models.
aj: vendor also asked about return path for the FRA RMA units — they want clarity on who handles re-export documentation if we re-route replacements to US. That will affect customs hold duration.
sophie: We should confirm KYC for re-export and whether vendor covers brokerage. I can take point with customs broker — ETA to get paperwork: ~24–48h.
lara: Can procurement negotiate freight credit if we accept EU delay? vendor offered a $2k credit per batch if we absorb the EU wait — does that change math?
ev: Quick back-of-envelope: Option A (reroute 20): +$120k freight, but avoids ~2–3w lost revenue and manual mitigation ops. Option B (hold EU & take $2k credit per batch): credit ~ $40k, but risk higher ops overhead and potential SLA mitigation. I'll post a small spreadsheet in ~45m.
aj: tagging @sophie to confirm customs docs and @evan for final cost calc. Also need decision by EOD to lock vendor routing.
sophie: I'll start broker outreach now, cc vendor.
lara: procurement, please open a spot buy request for 15 H100s with soft cap $1.3M. Reference thread TS 1699965432.
procurement (via aj): request noted — initiating RFQ.
logistics-bot: AWB FX123456789NL status updated: pickup scheduled. FX987654321NL (EU batch) status: pending customs clarification.
ev: Uploaded quick delta table: https://redwood.internal/drive/briefs/procure-delta-1699965432 (will add numbers).
derek: Agreed path — Accept US reroute for the 20, apply loaners to critical EU clusters, procurement to pursue top-off 15. If paperwork blocks re-export, fallback to hold EU batch and apply $2k credit.
aj: OK setting decision: reroute 20 -> US. Sophie, keep pushing broker for paperwork and confirm whether vendor covers brokerage. Procurement continue RFQ. I'll update incident channel if EU service steps down. :ship: :white_check_mark:
lara: thanks — will update depot queue and label replacement set.``
